This finite construction certifies conditional **κ = 0.001672404744903063**, improving pinned PR1031's `0.001672167430672016` by exactly `237314231047 / 10^18`. The conservative result is `0.001672404742051193`; the retained PR589 bit supplier is unchanged and repriced.

Alexander Schwartzman's PR1030 dimension-seven end recipe transfers to helpers **574/575** of the seven-slot k8 word. Eight B frames and two early tails change, with the scalar program and entrance/center interfaces preserved. Helper width decreases **3730 → 3728** and local rank mass **5586 → 5584**. The preceding owner placement fails the improvement screen; the new complete 69,120-role map pays every exposed residual and all inherited full-invoice costs. The unchanged T16 controller admits it with prefix **397 < 512**, row coefficient **16469 < 20161**, rank mass **1041408** and deficit **5120**.

This is a distinct smaller-end construction, pending review. The last overlap scan found PR1082 claiming a larger `0.001672653061493085` on the preceding terminal interface. No best-pending-frontier or optimal packing claim is made. PR942's accepted selected certificate and `upstream/` are untouched.

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.12+:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/k8-rank7-composition/reproduce.py --work /tmp/k8-rank7-replay
python3 -I -B research/k8-rank7-composition/check_controls.py --replay /tmp/k8-rank7-replay
```

Expected: `PASS_K8_RANK7_COMPLETE_REPRODUCTION 0.001672404744903063` and `PASS_K8_RANK7_SEMANTIC_CONTROLS 10`.

Validation: fresh 21-stage k8 ancestry and 34 slot controls; all 704 exact scalar columns in both orientations; independent 512-point accounting; fresh native programs, wrappers and exact phases; original and new full T16 admissions; both moment engines and all 47 strict outer inequalities. Both admissions include 69 admission, 12 bit, 15 controller-mutation and six independent owner controls. Ten additional semantic and six package fault controls pass. The package replay and semantic controls also pass from an isolated copy containing only the 348 pinned main files and this package, in paths with spaces. The portable command explicitly reuses the frozen, freshly validated parent ancestry and freshly recomputes the new native and global obligations.

Base `2921874911956718fcaaaf9396fe8267b3cfa9f0`; consumed files unchanged at refreshed main `abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf`. Closed source archives, exact pins, search domain/budgets, certificates, ancestry receipts and source licenses are retained. No solver is needed for replay. Repository-wide historical suites and hosted CI are separate from these affected checks.

Credit: Alexander Schwartzman PR1030; PR1031 and preceding ownership; Hao Yan/FanPUYen PR858; ColdWitness/icekylinx PR1005; PR1018 and rohanarun PR987; NewBArch/Jeremy Kothe PR869; the credited PR799/741/685/645/635/589 lineage. Detailed credit and preserved notices are in NOTICE.md. Prepared for **1337isnot1337** with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; new material Apache-2.0.

All-size/compiler, common labels and mutable-source realization, whole-call physical hosting, precision/tape, exact recovery, analytic transfer and bit H1–H5 obligations remain inherited. This is a finite conditional certificate, not an unconditional theorem or full Lean proof.
